statement.excerpt: And for that matter people should be comparing GenAI revenue (on the order of low tens of billions per year, pre price wars) with GenAI expenditures (order half a trillion dollars to date), and doing the math, especially given the price wars induced by DeepSeek.

from_speaker: low tens of billions per year
half a trillion dollars to date
our_interpretation: Treat the amounts as approximate USD industry estimates, not exact audited figures.
Use realized calendar-2024 annual revenue as the latest completed annual period before the early-2025 price competition discussed in the post.
Cumulative expenditure runs from the industry's unspecified inception through 2025-02-26; no start date is invented.
The contract contains two measures with different periods. Its single metric_scope records that composite explicitly.
The ordinary reading is revenue in the lower tens of billions and cumulative spending roughly around $500 billion. The source supplies no precise tolerance.
The price-war reference qualifies the revenue period; it is not a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Consistently scoped industry estimates establish both realized annual pre-price-war GenAI revenue in the low tens of USD billions and cumulative GenAI expenditure around USD500 billion through publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Consistently scoped estimates place either component clearly outside its stated approximate magnitude. Evidence establishing one component and refuting the other would support a mixed assessment.
